# 5Bloc
> AEC project coordination for architect-led teams. Drawings, RFIs, client approvals — one workspace, no app to install.

5Bloc is the project coordination platform for Indian and US architecture practices. Architects run the job. Contractors bid and deliver. Vendors get discovered. Clients see progress in the browser.

## Product
- Architect-led project workspace (documents, RFIs, submittals, permits, invoices)
- Client portal with no app to install
- Contractor and vendor marketplace / discovery
- AI cost estimator and building-code checker

## Who it is for
Architect-led construction teams — principals, project architects, contractors, vendors, and clients — who currently run jobs on WhatsApp, email, and Excel.
